title: How ChatGPT Turns Text Into Answers: The Hidden Architecture
short_hook: Why AI predicts words, not meanings
description:
Learn how ChatGPT turns text into answers. We explore the hidden journey from your prompt to the result, covering the architecture, math, and tricks that make AI tick. In this video, we trace the steps from tokenization to the Transformer blocks. Have you ever wondered why an AI can write a poem but struggle with logic?
